visualCharacteristics.structure: Single-column stack of full-width collapsible items separated by horizontal rules; each item has a question row (uppercase bold text left, +/- toggle icon right) that expands to reveal the answer below; items start collapsed and open independently

contentPattern.structure: one row per question (7 on the source page), 2 cells: cell 1 = question text (plain text); cell 2 = answer (one or more paragraphs, lists, links, inline bold). Empty rows are skipped, a missing answer cell gives an empty answer, and empty headings or empty trailing elements in answers are removed. Extra cells are added to the answer
